sources.paraphrase: Anthropic (2024-10-22) presents the October snapshot as an upgrade of Claude 3.5 Sonnet relative to the earlier release, and says price and speed match that predecessor.
Anthropic (2025-08-05) calls Opus 4.1 an upgrade of Opus 4, keeps the listed price, and tells developers to change the API model id.
AWS (2025-08-05) uses drop-in replacement language for Opus 4.1 versus Opus 4.
Anthropic (2025-09-29) keeps Sonnet 4 token prices and describes 4.5 as a drop-in replacement for all uses.
Anthropic's Fable 5.1 page names Fable 5 as predecessor and compares Low/Medium effort. It also states product-surface defaults of High in Claude Code and Medium on Cowork / claude.ai.
The 0813 card calls this the official V4-Pro checkpoint that supersedes the preview and attaches a DSpark decoding module to the preview structure.
The V4 preview series includes Pro (1.6T total / 49B active) and Flash (284B / 13B).
